section.chapeau: No funds appropriated in this or any other Act for fiscal year 1990 may be used to implement or enforce the agreements in Standard Forms 312 and 4355 of the Government or any other nondisclosure policy, form or agreement if such policy, form or agreement:

paragraph.content: concerns information other than that specifically marked as classified; or, unmarked but known by the employee to be classified; or, unclassisfied but known by the employee to be in the process of a classification determination;

directly or indirectly obstructs, by requirement of prior written authorization, limitation of authorized disclosure, or otherwise, the right of any individual to petition or communicate with Members of Congress in a secure manner as provided by the rules and procedures of the Congress;
interferes with the right of the Congress to obtain executive branch information in a secure manner as provided by the rules and procedures of the Congress;
imposes any obligations or invokes any remedies inconsistent with statutory law:

section.continuation: Provided, That nothing in this section shall affect the enforcement of those aspects of such nondisclosure policy, form or agreement that do not fall within subsection (1)–(5) of this section.
